qe: In the Gaya tract the surveyor found a fine clear stream coming out of the hills through a narrow ravine, which he called the finest torrent seen in those parts. Which stream was it?
qh: गया क्षेत्र में सर्वेक्षक को पहाड़ियों से एक संकरी घाटी के रास्ते निकलती एक स्वच्छ धारा मिली, जिसे उन्होंने उन भागों का सबसे सुंदर झरना बताया। वह धारा कौन-सी थी?
e: Gaya kshetra ke sarvekshan me nadiyon tatha chhoti dhaaraon ka bahut vistrit varnan milta hai, kyunki inhi ke sahare sinchai tatha aane-jaane ke raaste bante the. Ek sthal par pahadi ke niche se ek chhoti tatha bilkul saaf dhara nikal rahi thi, jiska naam Mangura tha; yah sankari ghati yaani narrow ravine se bahar aati thi tatha us daur me ise un bhaagon ka sabse sundar tatha saaf torrent maana gaya, kyunki isme paani baaki sabhi dharaon tatha nadiyon se zyada tatha saaf tha. Isi kshetra me aage ek aur chhoti dhara mili jiska naam Disbar tha, jise wahan ka ek thakur apni seema batata tha. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki Gaya ka ilaaka chhoti-chhoti pahadi dharaon se bhara hua tha, jo kheti tatha gaon ki zaruraton ke liye mahatvapurn thin. Exam point: Gaya kshetra ki sabse saaf tatha sabse sundar dhara ka naam Mangura tha; yah pahadi ki sankari ghati se nikal kar bahar aati thi tatha us daur me ise sabse saaf torrent maana gaya; isi kshetra me Disbar naam ki ek aur chhoti dhara bhi thi.

qe: How wide was the sandy channel of the Sakri river which the surveyor crossed about a mile and a half from Nawadeh?
qh: नवादा से लगभग डेढ़ मील दूर सर्वेक्षक ने साकरी नदी जिस रेतीले पाट को पार किया, वह लगभग कितना चौड़ा था?
oe: About six or seven hundred yards
e: Gaya kshetra ke sarvekshan me sakri naam ki nadi ka chauda tatha retila pata mila. Nawadeh se lagbhag dedh mile door yah nadi tarche tareeke se paari ki gayi. Us samay us nadi ka paat ret se bhara hua tha tatha uski chaudai lagbhag chhah se saat sau gaj thi; lekin us mausam me usme paani bahut kam tha. Is kam paani ka istemal log kheti ke liye karte the - nadi ke paani ko chhoti-chhoti naharon yaani cuts ke zariye sinchai ki naharon me pahunchaya jaata tha, jo us ilake me bahut saari thin. Is tarah kshetra ki nadiyan barish ke samay chaudi tatha khatarnak ho jaati thin, lekin sookhe mausam me sinchai ka mukhya sahaara ban jaati thin. Exam point: sakri nadi ka retila paat lagbhag chhah se saat sau gaj chauda tha tatha us samay usme paani bahut kam tha; nadi ke paani ko chhoti cuts ke zariye sinchai ki naharon me pahunchaya jaata tha; us kshetra me aisi sinchai ki naharein bahut saari thin.

qe: A little over a mile from Nawadeh, by the side of an irrigation canal, the surveyor saw the most extensive deposit of what substance, which was carefully scraped by glass-makers and washermen?
qh: नवादा से लगभग एक मील आगे, सिंचाई की नहर के किनारे, सर्वेक्षक ने किस पदार्थ का सबसे विस्तृत जमाव देखा, जिसे काँच बनाने वाले तथा धोबी सावधानी से खुरचते थे?
e: Gaya kshetra me sarvekshan ke dauran ek mahatvapurn bhu-rasayanik nishan bhi mila. Nawadeh se thoda aage, sinchai wali nahar ke kinare, zameen ke ek chhote se hisse par soda ubharta yaani effloresce hota mila. Yah apne aap zameen me se nikalta hua soda us daur me sarvekshak ne jitne aise sthal dekhe the, un sabme sabse bada tatha sabse vistrit tha. Iska upyog do tarah ke kaamgar karte the - ek to kaanch yaani glass banane wale karigar, jinko soda kachcha maal chahiye hota tha, tatha doosre dhobi, jo ise kapde saaf karne yaani washing ke liye istemal karte the. Log ise turant khurach lete the, kyunki zameen me se nikla hua soda hawa tatha mausam ke asar se phir mitti me mil jaata tha. Exam point: Nawadeh se thoda aage nahar ke kinare soda ubharta hua mila, jo us daur ka sabse vistrit soda-sthal tha; ise kaanch banane wale karigar tatha dhobi khurach kar le jaate the; zameen se nikalta soda turant hi phir mitti me mil jaata tha, isliye use jaldi khuracha jaata tha.

qe: Which low narrow ridge of quartz, mixed with black dots, did the surveyor note about a mile and a half north of Akbarpur in the Gaya tract?
qh: गया क्षेत्र में अकबरपुर से लगभग डेढ़ मील उत्तर में सर्वेक्षक ने काले बिंदुओं से मिले क्वार्ट्ज़ की किस नीची संकरी कटक का उल्लेख किया?
e: Gaya kshetra me sarvekshan afsar ne pahadiyon tatha unke pattharon ka bahut vistrit varnan diya, kyunki inhi sthalon se khanij tatha patthar nikalte the. Akbarpur se lagbhag dedh mile uttar me kwartj yaani quartz ki ek nichhi tatha sankri kataar mili, jisme bade-bade daane aapas me jude hue the tatha unke beech kale-kale dot dikhte the; is kataar ko Serput ki pahadi kaha jaata tha. Isi kshetra me doosri taraf Kuri nadi thi; dahine or Kulana naam ki lambi kataar thi tatha uske pashchim sire se dakshin ki or Dhakni naam ka pattharon ka dher tha. Yah Dhakni wali choti pahadi safed mealy quartz tatha chandi rang ki abhrak yaani mica ki plates se bani thi, jabki badi pahadi me hornblende ka bada bhaari patthar milta tha. Aise varnan se pata chalta hai ki is kshetra ki bhu-banawat alag-alag khanijon ka mel hai. Exam point: Akbarpur se dedh mile uttar me kwartj ki nichhi sankri kataar thi jise Serput ki pahadi kehte the, jisme bade daane tatha kale dot milte the; Dhakni ki choti pahadi safed mealy quartz tatha mica ki plates se bani thi; Kulana naam ki lambi kataar bhi isi kshetra me thi.

qe: Which hill near Akbarpur, the larger one, consisted of masses of very fine hornblende, very heavy and found in lumps two or three feet in diameter?
qh: अकबरपुर के निकट कौन-सी बड़ी पहाड़ी बहुत महीन हॉर्नब्लेंड के सख्त तथा भारी पिंडों से बनी थी, जो दो-तीन फुट व्यास के टुकड़ों में मिलते थे?
e: Gaya kshetra ke pahadi ilake me har pahadi ke patthar alag-alag the tatha sarvekshak ne inhe alag-alag naamon se likha. Akbarpur ke paas do pahadiyan thin - ek chhoti tatha ek badi. Chhoti pahadi safed mealy quartz tatha mica ki plates se bani thi; iske ulta badi pahadi aisi mitti se bani thi, jisme bahut mahin hornblende ke bade-bade pind milte the, jo do se teen foot vyas ke the tatha bahut bhaari the. Isi kshetra me Kulana pahadi ke pashchim sire par mahin daane wala kwartj mila, jo pahadi ke niche ke hisse me laal tatha upper ke hisse me safed tha. Aise antar dikhate hain ki pattharon ke rang tatha banaawat unke banne ke tareeke tatha unme mile dhatuon par nirbhar karte hain, isliye ek hi choti pahadi ke alag-alag hisson me alag patthar mil sakte hain. Exam point: Akbarpur ke nikat badi pahadi mahin hornblende ke do se teen foot vyas wale bhaari pindon se bani thi; chhoti pahadi safed mealy quartz tatha mica ki plates ki thi; Kulana pahadi ke niche ka patthar laal tatha upar ka safed tha.

qe: Which tank, a mile and a half north of Nawadeh, with a Jain temple in its middle, was much choked with weeds?
qh: नवादा से डेढ़ मील उत्तर में कौन-सा तालाब था, जिसके बीच में जैन मंदिर था तथा जो बहुत अधिक खरपतवार से भरा पड़ा था?
e: Gaya kshetra me talaab tatha pokharon ka bhi mahatvapurn sthan tha, kyunki yahi gaon ki sinchai tatha puja ke kendra hote the. Nawadeh se lagbhag dedh mile uttar me Nakaur naam ka talaab tha. Yah talaab purab-pashchim ki taraf sabse zyada lamba tha tatha us daur me bahut saare paudhon se bhara hua tha, jisme nol-khumbha naam ka paudha khaas taur par phaila hua tha. Is talaab ke beech, ek chhote vargakar chabutre par ek gumbad wala mandir bana hua tha, jisme do purane tarashe patthar the tatha jahan manav pairon ke chinh bane the tatha unke charon or chhote abhilekh khude the. Us talaab ke beech pahunchne ke liye ek purani sadak tatha eenton ka bana saral pat tha, jo toota-phoota pada tha. Is tarah ek chhota talaab tatha uske beech ek mandir mil kar kshetra ke dharmik tatha krishi-jeevan ka chitra banate hain. Exam point: Nakaur talaab Nawadeh se dedh mile uttar me tha tatha uske beech sthit mandir me do purane tarashe patthar the; talaab purab-pashchim lamba tatha nol-khumbha paudhe se bhara hua tha; wahan pahunchne ke liye eenton ka ek purana tatha toota hua pat tha.
